nextSlice.title: Add saved audit sessions and regression comparison
scope: Define a versioned project-local session index without adding a database or cloud dependency
Preserve immutable historical reports and expose recent sessions in the native Chinese panel
Compare current and baseline sessions by stable asset path and rule id
Classify new, persistent, resolved, and collection-failure changes with traceable evidence
Extend fixtures, tests, Demo flows, host lifecycle evidence, documentation, and screenshots
nonGoals: No cloud service, external database, user account, or telemetry upload
No asset mutation or automatic repair
No automatic CI gate or team notification in this slice
No compatibility claim beyond hosts actually tested
validationCommands: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff check Content/Python Demo/Scripts tests scripts
nextSlice.evidenceCeiling: Fixtures may prove comparison determinism; BuildPlugin may prove compilation; only fresh Unreal host sessions and Slate evidence may prove saved-history integration.
acceptance: Existing reports remain readable and are never overwritten when saved as history
The session index tolerates missing or invalid historical files with localized diagnostics
Comparison results deterministically classify new, persistent, resolved, and failed items
Recent sessions and comparison state are usable from the native Chinese panel
A fresh independent Unreal host lifecycle validates history and comparison without touching existing user sessions
README, Demo tutorial, and screenshots show the session comparison workflow
